_frame.Z: image -y, so Z is UP. The flip happens once, here.
_frame.depth: Y/depth is NOT measured this phase; frontal only.
_frame.caution: X is an IMAGE-space width. DNA neutral joint translations are PARENT-RELATIVE, so image +x is not known to be joint +x for any joint, and may differ between regions. The axis test decides that, not this.
